title: Maximum Matching Of Players With Trainers
description:
A player can be matched to a trainer when the player's ability is at most the trainer's capacity. Each player and trainer can be used at most once. Return the maximum number of matches.

## Examples

```text
Input: players = [4,7,9], trainers = [8,2,5,8]
Output: 2
```

```text
Input: players = [1,1,1], trainers = [10]
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- Both arrays have length 1..10^5
- `1 <= players[i], trainers[j] <= 10^9`
